description: A high-ceilinged flat with a picture rail and a boarded-up fireplace. A kitchenette fills the old scullery. The sash window looks over the Strand to the boats. In the afternoon the light off the water goes gold on the picture rail. The bathroom is through a panelled door at the back.

window.description: A tall sash window over the rooftops. It rattles in a north wind.
window.name: the sash window

name: Corbett Mansions, Unit 8A
